يمتعضوا (form VIII)
# يَمْتَعِضُوا (yamtaʕiḍū) /jam.ta.ʕi.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# يُمْتَعَضُوا (yumtaʕaḍū) /jum.ta.ʕa.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
